title: trackerMachineStatus
responsibility: Judges a computer as ok, busy, overloaded or offline from its resource samples and names the reasons.

inputs.name: trackerActualUtilization.sample
inputs.description: Latest host reading with CPU utilization and memory availability or pressure.

inputs.name: trackerMachineRole.node
inputs.description: Fleet node name of the computer.

inputs.name: trackerMacRole.role
inputs.description: Fleet role assigned to the computer.

inputs.name: trackerMacSessionRamSlots.availableMB
inputs.description: Estimated available memory in MB used to size the launch capacity.

inputs.name: trackerMacSessionRamSlots.freePercent
inputs.description: Percentage of usable memory free, or null when no memory reading is available.

inputs.name: trackerMacReportedRamSlots.ram
inputs.description: Reported total memory and available or pressure-based free percentages.

inputs.name: trackerSessionOverload.row
inputs.description: Fleet record containing the computer role, current status and reasons.

inputs.name: trackerMachineStatus.latest
inputs.description: Newest resource sample, or null when the computer never reported one.

inputs.name: trackerMachineStatus.recent
inputs.description: Earlier samples used to measure swap growth over ten minutes.

inputs.name: trackerMachineStatus.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds.

outputs.name: trackerSampleOfflineMs
outputs.description: Sample age in milliseconds after which a computer is offline.

outputs.name: trackerBusyLoadPerCore
outputs.description: Five-minute load per core above which a computer is busy.

outputs.name: trackerMachineStatus
outputs.description: Status, the reasons for it and the sample age in seconds.
